subject: general
question: A can do ⁽¹⁾/⁽⁵⁾th of some work in 12 days, B can do 20% of the same work in 10 days, C can do ⁽¹⁾/⁽⁶⁾th of the work in 8 days and D can do ⁽¹⁾/⁽⁵⁾th of the work in 12 days. Who will complete the work first if all four started to work at the same time?
solution:
**Given:**

A can do 1/5 of the work in 12 days

B can do 20% (or 1/5) of the work in 10 days

C can do 1/6 of the work in 8 days

D can do 1/5 of the work in 12 days

**Formula used:**

Work rate = Fraction of work / Time

**Calculations:**

A's work rate = 1/5 / 12

⇒ A's work rate = 1 / 60

B's work rate = 1/5 / 10

⇒ B's work rate = 1 / 50

C's work rate = 1/6 / 8

⇒ C's work rate = 1 / 48

D's work rate = 1/5 / 12

⇒ D's work rate = 1 / 60

Since the one with the highest work rate will complete the work first, we compare the rates:

A: 1 / 60

B: 1 / 50

C: 1 / 48

D: 1 / 60

⇒ C has the highest work rate

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
